old: **(2) Restriction costs intensity, not reach.** In the same comparison the neuron-restricted `p546` covered **41 %** of total brain area against CAG *«covering up to 42 %»* — a ratio of **0.98** recomputed from those two printed values — at about **one third** of the mean intensity (**154.0** against **474.8** relative fluorescence units, i.e. **0.324**), with **72 %** of its signal colocalising with neurons and **1.9 %** with astrocytes.
new: **(2) Lower intensity and a smaller median area; only the maxima coincide.** In the same comparison (Fig. 4C, boxplots, n = 8 to 10 per promoter, four weeks after neonatal (P0 to P1) intracerebroventricular AAV9; the legend does not define the box or the whiskers, and the whiskers end on the extreme plotted points) the neuron-targeted `p546` gave lower EGFP intensity than CAG and a smaller EGFP-positive brain area at the median plotted point; the plotted ranges overlap (about 7.9 to 41.9 against 19.4 to 42.4 percent) and the maxima coincide. The text gives `p546` as *«comparable to CAG (41% of the total brain area)»* and CAG as *«covering up to 42%»*; these two values match the upper whisker ends, the largest plotted points (about 41.9 and 42.4 by eye; whether a plotted point is one animal is not stated), so the **0.98** ratio recomputed from the two printed values compares largest points, not median points. The plotted medians of percent area are about **23 %** for `p546` and about **39 %** for CAG (ratio about **0.60**, by eye; Table S1 prints Tukey-adjusted P = 0.0097 for CAG against `p546`), and the plotted median intensity is about 124 against 577 relative fluorescence units (ratio about **0.22**, by eye; Table S1 adjusted P below 0.0001). The text's *«Mean EGFP intensity»* of **154.0** against **474.8** RFU (ratio **0.32**; Table S1 also calls it mean intensity) agrees with group means read from the plotted dots (about 170 and 500, by eye) and differs from the plotted medians. For `p546`, **72 %** of its signal colocalised with neurons and **1.9 %** with astrocytes.
